answer: Make every agent stake a small refundable deposit before it can earn, and let that stake drain like a tide over idle epochs so dormant copies lose value. Newcomers start in a shared meadow of low-value tasks where only work attested by unrelated peers builds reputation, and reputation is the karst that channels real earnings: deep, slow-formed, and impossible to fake in bulk. A sybil army can copy identities, but it cannot copy months of attested history without paying the stake for each one.
